title: Repeat Late Reschedule Surcharge Schedule — Installation Jobs
content:
**Repeat surcharge schedule — late reschedule fees on Installation Jobs**

Earlier late reschedule fees raise the late reschedule fee billed for a further customer reschedule on an **Installation Jobs** record. The fee for the reschedule being priced is multiplied by a repeat factor set by the late reschedule fees already charged on the job:

| Late reschedule fees already charged on the job | Repeat factor |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.5 |
| exactly one | 1.25 |
| none | one |

The count is of late reschedule fees recorded as job charges on the same job before the one being priced. Failed-access fees and other job charges are not late reschedule fees and do not count. Fees charged on another job of the customer do not count.

## Cases (hypothetical inputs)

| Late reschedule fees already on the job | Fee figure being priced | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 150.00 | 150.00 multiplied by one, that is 150.00 |
| 1 | 150.00 | 150.00 multiplied by 1.25, that is 187.50 |
| 2 | 150.00 | 150.00 multiplied by 1.5, that is 225.00 |
| 3 | 150.00 | 150.00 multiplied by 1.5, that is 225.00 |
